name: Punto de Acceso General
body: A sitemap, language alternates that point at each other, HSTS, and FAQ-style content. But the Galician home page is titled "Punto de Acceso General | Inicio", word for word the Spanish one, so search can't tell them apart.
lesson: Translate the title and description too, so each language version names itself.
summary: administracion.gob.es scores 78 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 22 are at risk, and 16 pass. Fix first: 1 form control has no label.

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /informacion/noticias. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 17 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /informacion/formas-recibir-orientacion/canales-atencion, /ca, /gl and 13 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 16 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Adobe Analytics appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: 2 titles are shared by more than one page
fix.evidence: "Punto de Acceso General | Inicio" on /, /gl. "Punto de Acceso General | Inici" on /ca, /va.
fix.fix: Write a title that names what is different about each page.

fix.title: The content security policy has gaps
fix.evidence: script-src allows 'unsafe-inline', script-src allows 'unsafe-eval', object-src is not 'none', base-uri is not set.
fix.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonces or hashes, limit hosts, and add object-src 'none' and base-uri 'self'.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Language alternates point at each other
